episodes.title: LAWYER TAKES: What You Didn't See in "You Can See Everything"
episodes.description:
What can Elizabeth Holmes teach us about narcissists, manipulation, and high conflict situations? Rebecca Zung, The Leverage Lawyer, breaks down the tactics manipulators use to gain credibility, control information, divide people, and avoid accountability. Discover how to recognize borrowed credibility, gaslighting, smear campaigns, and deception, and why documentation, contradictions, and firsthand evidence can be more powerful than arguments or outrage. If you're dealing with a narcissist, false narratives, or a high conflict divorce, learn why data beats drama, patterns create proof, and a well documented record can help you build leverage.
